full: Same cookies. Why do the last two look more tempting? In a 1975 study, cookies from a nearly empty jar were rated more desirable. Cookies that ran low because others wanted them were rated higher still. That's scarcity. What's running out can seem more valuable. So show real limits, true stock counts and real end dates. But a fake only two left is a known dark pattern. Follow Warbins to decode how brands sell.
